description: On the table in front of you there’s a small white cabinet-like model, and a small black cube with an “L” on it nearby. The right hand moves forward to the cabinet, pulls a side panel/bench piece outward to open the compartment, briefly reaches inside to remove the small “L” cube and sets it down on the table, then pushes the panel/bench piece back in to close the cabinet while the left hand stays mostly resting and not touching anything.
